summary: Join our comprehensive course on Managing Unstructured Information and Content. Master techniques to streamline data management and improve decision-making.
lede: Managing Unstructured Information and Content gives you practical ways to turn scattered files, messages, attachments, and document versions into organized, usable knowledge. You will learn to classify content, establish naming and version controls, and build repositories that are easier to search and trust. The course also covers metadata, retention, access control, and compliance practices that reduce duplication and protect sensitive information. Apply these methods across SharePoint, Google Drive, OneDrive, email, ERP attachments, and team chat to strengthen collaboration, governance, and knowledge continuity.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who regularly manage, store, share, approve, archive, or retrieve content.
modules: Unstructured Information: The Hidden Productivity Tax
Classification and Taxonomy That People Will Actually Use
Naming Conventions, Version Control, and Single Source of Truth
Security, Privacy, and Access Control for Real Work Environments
Workflow Tools and Platforms: Making Systems Work for People
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with document processing tools and collaborative platforms such as SharePoint, Google Drive, or OneDrive.
